svg.desc: Branded interface and fictional purchasing process, not a live product screenshot or customer data.

g.text: How to find a cited source
How do I request a laptop for a new colleague?
Start with a purchase request: purpose, specs and budget.
After manager approval, Purchasing gets quotes and orders. Inspect on arrival.
Follow the application and approval rules in the cited process.
